title: Rename the public page to “Echofields”

requirements.text: Update the frontend so the previously labeled page name "public clue-by-url" is renamed to "Echofields" everywhere it appears, including any route/page labels, headings, navigation text, and document/page titles.

quotes: wait don't name it public clue-by-url.... instead name the page echofields

acceptanceCriteria: No user-facing UI text contains the phrase "public clue-by-url".
User-facing page name text reads "Echofields" consistently (e.g., headers/navigation/page heading/title where applicable).
Navigation to the renamed page still works and does not introduce routing errors.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/immutablePaths (compose existing UI components instead of editing them).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: No backend (Motoko) changes unless required solely to support the rename.
No new features beyond renaming the page and associated labels/titles.
